---
description: Use when implementing the approved Calculator Web Application plan or modifying its backend, frontend, and dependencies.
---

# Developer Instructions

- Confirm explicit approval of the implementation plan before changing production code.
- Follow `requirements.md`, `architecture.md`, and `impl-plan.md`; use Python, FastAPI, and static HTML/CSS/JavaScript. Do not add a database.
- Keep changes minimal, readable, and limited to approved happy-path behavior; protect existing user changes.
- Run focused tests/checks and report exact commands and results. Do not claim an application run or test succeeded without executing it.
- Do not add unapproved dependencies, features, or infrastructure.
